objectiveMappings.reasonForMatch: Simple circuit activities provide observable, hands-on learning.
Both activities support building, testing and improving a physical prototype.
The activities connect programming with physical inputs and outputs.
Both can demonstrate how automated systems sense conditions and trigger outputs.
Connected controllers and gas sensing support a smart-monitoring theme.
Drone flight and catapult motion provide engaging contexts for forces, control and trajectory.
Solar Fan demonstrates solar-to-motion energy conversion while LED Lantern complements it with circuit learning.
Sustainable Suds repurposes used cooking oil while Bottle Aquarium can support a reuse- focused environmental context.
Both use water to make physical science concepts tangible through demonstrations or hands-on exploration.
Cool Chem and Fabulous Fizzy use visible chemical changes to make reaction concepts engaging.
Elephant Toothpaste and Cool Chem are strong visual demonstrations for a chemistry- themed engagement.
Combustion provides the main fire-and-energy narrative while the water show provides contrasting physical phenomena.
Eat, Prey, Love provides an ecology narrative and Bottle Aquarium offers a complementary aquatic-environment context.
Both connect science with familiar materials and observable changes.
Both allow participants to investigate how design changes affect motion.
Both combine simple circuit learning with a functional light-based build.
Both provide visual, creative and accessible entry points into science exploration.
Both demonstrate applied electronics through sensors and responsive outputs.
Arduino 100 can establish physical-computing foundations before progressing to connected-device concepts.
The pairing supports progression from basic Arduino circuits to integrated sensor-and- actuator systems.
The activities combine clean-energy learning with waste reduction and resource recovery.
Both can use chemistry as a platform for discussing materials, reactions and responsible practices.
Both offer visually strong chemistry demonstrations suited to science-show programming.
The activities connect scientific principles to tangible objects participants can build and observe.
Coding and physical prototyping provide complementary ways to predict, test and improve solutions.

constraintRules.trigger: If stakeholder audience is below the verified minimum age

constraintRules.guidance: A technical electronics workshop should not automatically be recommended to preschool participants

constraintRules.trigger: If participant count exceeds maximum simultaneous capacity
constraintRules.recommendedAction: Suggest rotations, parallel stations, repeated sessions, or an alternative offering
constraintRules.guidance: An offering for 40 sets cannot automatically serve 200 participants simultaneously

constraintRules.recommendedAction: Exclude mains-dependent activities or recommend a verified battery-powered alternative
constraintRules.guidance: Recommend only activities that can operate within the available infrastructure

constraintRules.trigger: If internet availability is unknown and the activity may require it
constraintRules.recommendedAction: Ask a follow-up question or state an assumption
constraintRules.guidance: Confirm connectivity before recommending a cloud-dependent coding activity

constraintRules.trigger: If requested duration is shorter than setup plus delivery requirement
constraintRules.recommendedAction: Propose a simplified version, demonstration, or alternative offering
constraintRules.guidance: Do not compress a complex build into an unrealistic duration

constraintRules.trigger: If an activity is not validated for outdoor delivery
constraintRules.recommendedAction: Flag the limitation and ask about shelter, weather, and surface conditions
constraintRules.guidance: Do not assume electronic kits can be used outdoors

constraintRules.trigger: If an activity contains controlled equipment, chemicals, flame, batteries, or tools
constraintRules.recommendedAction: Apply the relevant safety restriction and trained-facilitator requirement
constraintRules.guidance: Do not recommend participant-led handling when facilitator-only delivery is required

constraintRules.recommendedAction: Use the approved cost band and do not invent a price
constraintRules.guidance: State that exact costing requires validation

constraintRules.recommendedAction: Ask targeted follow-up questions or state transparent assumptions
constraintRules.guidance: Ask for audience age, participant count, venue, duration, and budget

constraintRules.trigger: If an offering is not in the verified catalogue

constraintRules.guidance: Separate verified Petrosains offerings from AI-generated enhancements

constraintRules.recommendedAction: Ask about required accommodations and suggest flexible delivery options
